January 2027 ISM® Services PMI® Report

In January, the Services PMI® registered 50.1 percent, compared to December’s figure of 49.8 percent.

The Prices Index registered 65.0 percent in January.

The next ISM® Services PMI® Report featuring February 2027 data will be released at 10:00 a.m. ET on Thursday, February 4, 2027.
